items:
Top Reasons to Book Emerald Palace:

* Public Beach Access Approx. 0.2 Miles Away
* Private Pool/Spa With Heating Options (Fee Applies)
* Golf Cart (6-Seater LSV) Included At The Home
* Dog Friendly Home (Fees and Restrictions Apply)
* 1st Floor Game Room – Foosball, Pool Table, Kitchenette
* 3rd Floor Indoor Movie Theater
* Thor 6-Burner Gas Range
* Natural Gas Grill
* Professionally Managed

Emerald Palace is an elegant 10-bedroom, 9 and a half-bathroom luxury retreat that accommodates up to 28 guests, offering an elevated coastal experience just moments from the beach. Arranged across three spacious levels, this impressive home blends refined design with resort-style amenities, creating a sophisticated yet inviting setting for an unforgettable 30A escape.

The second floor serves as the heart of the home, where an open-concept layout seamlessly connects the living, dining, and chef’s kitchen areas. The gourmet kitchen is thoughtfully designed for entertaining on a grand scale, featuring generous prep space and high-end finishes that complement the home’s upscale design. A separate sitting area on this level provides additional space to unwind. On the first floor, a dedicated game room with a pool table, foosball table, and kitchenette offers a lively gathering space, while the private indoor movie theater creates a cinematic experience without leaving the home. King bedrooms throughout feature private ensuite bathrooms, complemented by two bunk rooms and an additional bunk nook on the third floor for flexible accommodations.

Outdoors, the private backyard is designed for luxurious living, centered around a sparkling pool and spa with ample loungers for soaking up the Florida sunshine. A covered patio with a grill provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining and evening gatherings. The complimentary 6-passenger golf cart (LSV) makes getting around the area effortless, while public access at Ed Walline Regional Beach Access is just a 4-minute walk or short ride away. You’ll be steps from local favorites like Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, The Perfect Pig, and Sunrise Coffee Co., as well as boutique shopping and scenic paths along 30A. With its generous layout, elevated amenities, and prime location, Emerald Palace delivers a truly elegant coastal retreat.

Home Layout and Bedroom Details:

1st Floor:

Game Room + Kitchenette: The game room offers a lively space for entertainment, featuring a pool table and foosball table for friendly competition. A convenient kitchenette with a sink and mini refrigerator enhances the space, making it easy to prepare drinks and snacks while enjoying time together.

Bedroom + Bathroom #1: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. It has a cozy lounge area with a sofa and direct access to the back patio. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #2: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, and a mounted flat-screen TV. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Backyard: This resort-style backyard exudes luxury and style with its gorgeous private pool and attached spa, surrounded by ample lounge seating. There is a covered patio, a dining set, and a gas grill for convenience. The pool/spa can also be heated in the cooler months.

2nd Floor:

Kitchen: This gourmet kitchen is fully stocked for making meals with large families, featuring polished wooden cabinetry and generous prep space. Amenities include a Thor 6-burner gas range, 2 dishwashers, a microwave, refrigerator, toaster, Keurig, coffeepot, crockpot, griddle, and blender, as well as all the standard utensils and cookware. The island offers additional seating for 6.

Dining Room: Located across from the kitchen, this dining room has a beautiful modern table with seating for 8.

Living Room: This spacious living room is filled with natural light from expansive windows that showcase scenic views from both balconies. A large sectional sofa anchors the space, offering comfortable seating for gathering and relaxing. The open layout flows into the kitchen and dining areas, while a mounted flat-screen TV provides easy entertainment in an inviting setting.

Bedroom + Bathroom #3: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. It has direct access to the balcony overlooking the pool. There is a private bathroom attached with a Jack-and-Jill vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #4: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, twin/twin bunk, dresser, 2 nightstands, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Half Bathroom #10: The half bath is located directly off the living room for convenience.

3rd Floor:

Bedroom + Bathroom #5: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. It has direct access to the front balcony. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #6: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, and a mounted flat-screen TV. It has direct access to the front balcony. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom #7: This bedroom includes 2 twin/twin bunks, perfect for kids or larger groups. It shares Bathroom #7 with Bedroom #8.

Bathroom #7: This bathroom is located in the hallway across from the bunk rooms and includes a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom #8: This bedroom includes 2 twin/twin bunks, perfect for kids or larger groups. It shares Bathroom #7 with Bedroom #7.

Bedroom #9 + Bathroom #8: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. It has direct access to the balcony overlooking the pool. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom #10 + Bathroom #9: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, dresser, 2 nightstands, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. It has direct access to the front balcony. There is a private bathroom attached with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Hallway: There is a twin/twin bunk in the hallway nook, perfect for kids or larger groups.

Theater Room: This space has 6 reclining chairs and a large screen, ideal for family movie nights.

Laundry: This room has a full-sized washer and dryer. You will find all the bathroom linens stored here.

House Rules:
-This is a NON-smoking property.

Student Booking Policies:
-College student groups must all inquire and get approval before booking. Rates for student groups are subject to change; the price will be determined upon inquiry.
-If a college student group is accepted, they will be subject to a $100.00 fully refundable damage deposit per person.
-Golf carts are not included for groups under the age of 25 or college student groups.

Pets:
-This home is pet-friendly, up to 30lb in size, but all pets must be approved and are subject to a pet fee upon approval. Please request approval before booking.

Parking:
-All cars must be in the driveway. 8 cars maximum. No Trailers, RVs, Scooters, Boats, or Motorcycles are permitted without approval.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
